title: Ollama v0.40.3 released today with server guard fixes
summary: Ollama v0.40.3 published Oct 11 (Shanghai time) fixes server duplicate/downgrade guard warnings; llama.cpp shipped b11552 yesterday with three consecutive builds.
body:
Ollama v0.40.3 published Oct 11 (Shanghai time) fixes server duplicate/downgrade guard warnings; llama.cpp shipped b11552 yesterday with three consecutive builds.

Source: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/tag/v0.40.3
summary_en: An automated note reports that Ollama v0.40.3, released October 11 (Shanghai time), contains server fixes hiding duplicate and downgrade guard warnings. It also notes llama.cpp shipped build b11552 on October 10, marking three consecutive builds: b11549 adds a slot-save-path environment variable, while b11548 fixes mtmd speculative decoding. Source links point to GitHub releases for both projects. The note's status is auto-generated.
